ds2484.docs:
The `ds2484` platform provides access to 1-Wire busses via DS2484 device using the [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) for communication.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via DS2484](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds2484)*

gpio.docs:
The `gpio` platform uses the CPU to generate the bus signals on an on-board GPIO pin.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via GPIO](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/gpio)*
